ops.title: Cadence review: check the actual thread for say about replies
ops.description:
Owner: j6563-cadence change owner.
Evidence at HEAD c86d7e9ba5c544b31b1961eab0e6ee1fda56d4a6: talk.py:475 uses place(post); talk.py:680-681 ignores about, while talk.py:719-723 resolves its card thread and talk.py:765-766 sends --about. An ordinary say(text='On it.', about=<card>) in a paced thread bypasses uncadenced because it is checked as the DM root.
Next step: resolve the actual about destination before comparing promise_thread, reusing the existing card resolution path. Add regression coverage through say and its dry-run path. Review was static; no tests were run.

ops.text: A normal about reply into a paced order thread is refused without a timely promise, including in dry_run.
An about reply with a timely promise and replies into unrelated threads retain their existing behavior.
